page_title: CAG 1-1 LEC | Cagliari v Lecce 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' 9:16 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
90+2' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
90+1' Substitution. Adam Obert (Cagliari) in, Nahitan Nandez out.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Simone Scuffet makes a simple save.
88' Alexis Blin (Lecce) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Simone Scuffet stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
88' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the left post. What a great chance!
86' The corner kick falls to Federico Baschirotto (Lecce), who does his best to finish. The snap shot, however, only marks the left post!
86' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.
84' 1 - 1 Goal! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) scores after an assist by Pontus Almqvist that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
82' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
79' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
78' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
78' Although Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is just on the bench, Matteo Marcenaro has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
78' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
77' Substitution. Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) replaces Tommaso Augello.
75' A corner kick by Lecce is thwarted by the well prepared Simone Scuffet (Cagliari).
74' A yellow card for bad language! Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
74' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
74' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lecce.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
72' Substitution. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) on for Remi Oudin.
72' Here is a change. Ylber Ramadani is going off and Luca Gotti gives the last tactical orders to Pontus Almqvist (Lecce).
71' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
69' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) will replace Zito Luvumbo.
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:7.
65' Simone Scuffet makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) after a cross from the side.
64' It's a yellow card for Simone Scuffet (Cagliari).
63' Remi Oudin (Lecce) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just wide of the left post.
63' A cross from a corner kick by Cagliari is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
63' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
59' That will be all from Patrick Dorgu who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
58' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
57' Corner kick. Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is ready to send the ball into the box.
57' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
57' Cagliari restart play with a quick free kick.
56' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
54' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
53' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
52' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
52' Good movement by Alexis Blin (Lecce), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
52' 6:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
49' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
47' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
46' Half-time substitution. Gabriele Zappa is replaced by Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Ranieri gives a chance to Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) and Gianluca Lapadula is off.
46' Luca Gotti makes a switch. Nicola Sansone (Lecce) is coming on in place of Roberto Piccoli at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Matteo Marcenaro has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Claudio Ranieri isn't happy on the touchline after referee Matteo Marcenaro shows him a yellow card.
44' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
43' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari)! Let's see what he decides.
42' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
38' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
34' None of the Lecce players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
33' Remi Oudin (Lecce) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
33' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle after Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Lecce have a free kick.
33' The total number of attempts is 6:1.
31' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
30' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
26' 1 - 0 Goal! Gianluca Gaetano provides Yerry Mina (Cagliari) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
25' The linesman points to the corner flag, Cagliari are going to take it.
24' A player from Lecce commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
22' Lecce seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
18' The goal by Cagliari is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
18' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The Cagliari players aren’t happy.

16' Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.
14' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) will miss the next game.
14' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
13' Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
10' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
10' The free kick from long range, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Lecce are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
4' A player from Cagliari commits a rough challenge. Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Cagliari will kick the game off.
Matteo Marcenaro is introduced as the referee for today's match.
